title: Capstone Dataset and Baseline
outcome: By the end, I can explain capstone dataset and baseline using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Plan the plant capstone around independent groups and a baseline before collecting more rows.
given: Toy proposed dataset: 8 plants, 3 photos each. Development groupsA–F; final groupsG, H. Target is visible-spot status, with review for hidden leaves.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Define target
steps.detail: Write visible-spot and review rules before annotation.

steps.label: Split by groups
steps.detail: Keep all 18 A–F views in development and all 6 G/H views for final evaluation.

steps.label: Plan baseline
steps.detail: Fit majority label only from development training; record metrics and error types.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Fit majority label only from development training; record metrics and error types. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: A derived crop of plantG is added to training.
counterfactual.prediction: The final group separation is violated.
counterfactual.reason: The crop retains the same source plant identity even with a new file name.

student_task: What provenance field prevents the crop from appearing independent? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: Store original_plant_id=G and the parent image ID; all derived G records must remain with their assigned final group. Changed-case check: The final group separation is violated. The crop retains the same source plant identity even with a new file name.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: A well-planned split does not create sufficient sample size; two held-out plants support only a very narrow claim.
review_note: Reviewed Capstone Dataset and Baseline against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
